failureKnowledge: psc-failure-knowledge/1 binds context, scope, failed strategy, reproducer, evidence, validity horizon and supersession. Exact validity and byte checks still return advisory authority only.
migration: psc-knowledge-migration/1 binds source/destination objects and contexts, transformation, preservation claim and explicit losses. Caller selects exact subject/checker/claim class and allowed losses; registered certificate replay is required. Destination validity is always a separate fresh check.
reuse: A live knowledge handle requires current graph validity. A host-registered operation records actual task/input/output/knowledge IDs. A live use handle can create a psc-reuse-event/1 only after a host-selected output validator accepts the exact task/output/use subject. Serialized, cross-task, revoked and consumed handles cannot create events.
authority: Observed accepted reuse under explicit trusted operation/output adapters; no causal productivity or global theorem claim. Retrieval alone produces zero reuse events.
remaining: real theorem/interface/pass operation adapters with canonical implementation identities
